search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail DescribeInstanceAttribute 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "errorCode", "requestParameters.attribute" as eventSource, eventName, errorCode, requestedAttribute nodrop 
| where eventSource="ec2.amazonaws.com" and eventName="DescribeInstanceAttribute" and isBlank(errorCode) 
| if((requestedAttribute="userData"),1,0) as userDataRequestEvent 
| sum(userDataRequestEvent) as count 
| "EC2_DescribeInstanceUserData" as benchmarkname 
| "EventCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("EC2_DescribeInstanceUserData") in benchmarkname, values("EventCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
